resources.string: Use your key to run other people’s Tadolio
The platform sends you work from whoever needs it.
Only people who enter your invite code can use it, such as family or a group of friends. You can message them. Your phone must stay online.
You don’t have a Tadolio number yet. Claim one under “Tadolio number” in the side menu first.
Your invite code: send it to family or friends. Entering it binds them to you
Want to help others with your own key? Be a miner ›
Elder mode is on · turn it off in Settings
The home screen becomes a simple one with large text and hold-to-speak. To switch back, tap Settings at the top right of the home screen and turn off Elder mode.
